title: 109 and 582 Squadrons RAF - Bomber Command
memorial_details:
description: Rough-cut stone of remembrance (granite?) with polished, oval face for the dedicatory inscription, which is in black, upper-case lettering.  The stone is flanked by two low wooden planters.  The 2021 image reveals that a laurel bush has grown as a backdrop to the memorial.

Gold coloured RAF emblem in the upper centre of the stone.
